title: 01 / Signal Notch
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished landscape brand identity presentation board for Logly, a focused privacy-conscious product analytics dashboard for independent software operators. This is an original logo exploration. Flat vector-like sharp graphic design; refined agency art direction, generous whitespace, extremely clean typography. One cohesive logo system per board, repeat EXACTLY the same mark throughout all variants. Arrange a large hero horizontal symbol + wordmark in upper left, standalone mark upper right, three smaller variants in middle (black on white, white on dark, icon in rounded app tile), and a small realistic dashboard header/sidebar crop along bottom demonstrating the identity with Overview, Events, Live, Insights, Settings and a restrained analytics chart. Main logo text exactly "logly" in carefully kerned lowercase. Include small concept number and title at top, variants caption labels. No photography, no 3D, no gradients, no stock mockup objects, no mascots, no shields, no eyes, no infinity loops, no generic rising bar chart logo. App crop uses fictional aggregate data only. Output one high resolution board. Concept: 01 / Signal Notch. Design direction: A confident geometric L monogram: one thick vertical stem turns into a short horizontal foot, with a single square signal notch cut from the inner elbow. Compact iconic silhouette, restrained optical rounding only, unmistakable L at tiny sizes. Forest green #1F6B4F, off-white #F7F7F3, charcoal #1A1D1B. Wordmark geometric humanist sans, medium-bold. Calm precise operational instrument; app uses warm neutral surfaces and green chart.
